common_hub_unreachable: Cannot reach the Hub. Check that this phone is on the home network.
common_hub_answer_unknown: The Hub sent an answer this app does not understand. Update the app or the Hub, then try again.
common_feature_off: {feature} is switched off on this Hub. Switch it on on the Hub page under Features.
common_spoolman_unreachable: The Hub can't reach Spoolman right now. Try again in a minute.
common_offline_notice: Offline. Showing what was loaded {time}. {product} keeps trying.
common_offline_text: Check that this phone is on the home network.
common_cert_changed_notice: The Hub's certificate has changed. This phone stopped talking to it to stay safe.
common_not_paired_notice: This phone is no longer paired with the Hub.
common_leave_body: Your changes to {thing} are not saved.
common_load_wait: Loading into the printer… wait for its answer.
network_text: {product} reaches your Hub over your home network. Android asks your permission for that once.
network_no_ask: Android will not ask again. Allow local network access for {product} in the app's settings.
appearance_note: These choices are kept on this phone only.
nav_printers_off: Printers, switched off on this Hub
hub_state_checking: Checking the connection to the Hub…
hub_state_offline: Cannot reach {hub}. Check that this phone is on the home network.
hub_state_certificate: The Hub's certificate is not the one this phone paired with.
hub_state_unpaired: This phone is no longer paired with the Hub.
hub_state_network: Android needs your permission before {product} can reach the Hub on your network.
pair_banner_unpaired: This phone is no longer paired with the Hub. Pair it again to carry on.
pair_start_intro: Show a pairing code on the Hub page (Devices > Pair a phone), or run sudo {command} pair on the Hub. Then scan its QR code.
pair_start_found_looking: Still looking. A VPN or a guest Wi-Fi can hide the Hub; you can enter its address instead.
pair_scan_hint: Point the camera at the QR code
pair_scan_denied: The camera is needed to scan the pairing code. You can allow it in the phone's app settings, or enter the address by hand instead.
pair_scan_failed: The camera could not start, so the pairing code can't be scanned. Enter the Hub's address instead.
pair_address_error_port: The port must be a number from 1 to 65535.
pair_fingerprint_text: {address} presented this certificate fingerprint. Compare it with the fingerprint shown with the pairing code on the Hub page before you continue.
pair_fingerprint_rejected: The fingerprint didn't match, so something else may be answering at this address. Nothing was paired.
pair_code_text: Type the 6-digit code shown on the Hub page.
pair_cert_stored_body: This happens after the Hub was reinstalled or restored. If nothing like that was done, something else may be answering at its address.
pair_cert_stored_hint: Check the fingerprint on the Hub page under Devices.
pair_cert_qr_title: This pairing code doesn't match the Hub
pair_cert_qr_body: The QR code names a different certificate than the Hub at this address shows.
pair_cert_manual_title: The Hub's certificate changed while pairing
pair_cert_manual_body: Start again and compare the fingerprint once more.
pair_error_not_hub: Something answers at this address, but it is not a {product} Hub. Check the address and port.
pair_error_expired: This pairing code has expired or was already used. Show a new one on the Hub page.
pair_error_not_code: That is not a {product} pairing code.
pair_error_refused: The Hub did not accept this code. Check it and try again.
home_update_hub_newer: Update the app: the Hub is newer, so some things may not work.
home_add_text: Photograph each label, check what was read, then add. Nothing is saved until you add.
home_label_reader_off: The Label Reader is switched off on this Hub. Add the spool by hand, or switch it on on the Hub page under Features.
home_draft_discard_body: Its photos and edits are removed from this phone.
settings_hub_page_line: Features, keys, devices and backups are set on the Hub page.
settings_hub_page_error_browser: No browser on this phone could open it.
settings_hub_page_error_address: The Hub's address isn't known yet.
settings_hub_check_title: Check the fingerprint when pairing by address
settings_hub_check_help: When this is off, the app trusts the certificate a Hub presents when you pair by typing its address. A scanned QR code is always checked.
settings_hub_skip_body: Only do this on a network you trust.
settings_hub_forget_body: This phone stops using it until you pair again. Drafts stay on this phone.
settings_updates_up_to_date: This app is up to date.
settings_licences_line: {product} is free software under GPL-3.0-or-later. It comes with no warranty.
